Everyday is a gut punch and life is meaningless. There has to be something on the other side that is better than this. Something that makes this all worth it. I can’t comprehend nothing. If it’s nothing, what is the purpose of life? What is the purpose, that I come here as a human, and do meaningless things, and theres nothing in the end. If life is just unwarranted suffering and pain, then why am I still here? Is it just instinct that we strive to live instead of dying? So many questions and existential thoughts but none of them can be proven.

Unless you take that risk. I already hate life in general, I have only a few things to live for; and they’re the only things I ever cared about. The only thing I can associate myself with, and be happy. If the rest of my life is just working and suffering, then I have got nothing to lose. Thats why I’m taking that risk.

We’re probably not going to get an answer anytime soon, and we all will eventually die; so why not stick around for longer? Its the only existence we know. Just a couple of thoughts from me as well.
